subject: January Remote Learning and COVID-19 Testing Program
overview: The School Committee announced a temporary shift to remote learning for January 2021 and reviewed the district's COVID-19 testing program results. The committee also accepted significant donations for the robotics and world language departments.

items.title: Roll Call and Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the previous meeting following a roll call.

items.title: Recognition of Boy Scout Troop 416
items.summary: Members welcomed Boy Scout Troop 416 and acknowledged their community service work and efforts toward their communication merit badges.

items.title: Medford Educational Foundation Presentation
items.summary: The Medford Educational Foundation presented an updated mission statement and reported on the distribution of digital micro-grants for classroom software and equipment.

items.title: Public Participation on Literacy Instruction
items.summary: The committee heard emailed public comments advocating for evidence-based literacy instruction and specific reading outcomes in the superintendent's evaluation.

items.title: Superintendent's Report and Remote Learning Schedule
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent announced that instruction will be fully remote from January 4 through January 13 to avoid post-holiday virus surges, with in-person learning resuming January 14.

items.title: High School Orchestra Virtual Performance
items.summary: The committee viewed a virtual concert produced by the Medford High School Orchestra and thanked teacher Emma Baptist for the technical effort required to coordinate remote musicians.

items.title: COVID-19 Health Metrics and Testing Program Update
items.summary: Health officials reviewed community positivity rates and the district's PCR testing program, which has identified 18 positive staff cases and 15 student cases out of over 7,000 tests administered.

items.title: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Grant Approval
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a grant totaling approximately $32,000 from the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs to support the high school's Advanced Placement Italian program.

items.title: Vocational School Robotics Department Donation
items.summary: Accepted a $4,000 donation from teacher Sam Christie to be used by the Medford Vocational Technical High School.

items.title: Resolutions and Condolences
items.summary: The committee offered sincere condolences to the families of Nick Tomaszuk and Anne Marie McNamara.
